purpose: Final targeted closure pass for Emmen, Enkhuizen and Ermelo plus Eemnes application/fee currentness check.

verified: Municipality confirms one current Omgevingsplan for the whole municipality, including former zoning plans under transition; rules must be read per concrete address in Regels op de kaart.
The municipal site gives a step-by-step address lookup method for the current plan and integrated legacy components.
Concept request is an official pre-application route when a plan conflicts with the plan or feasibility is uncertain.
For analogous contrary-use residential activities the municipality explicitly uses an omgevingsvergunning 'afwijken' route where the activity is not already allowed in the plan.
feesQuality: A current 2026 municipal example tariff of EUR 296.10 exists for deviation for temporary housing/working-at-home/B&B, but this is not generalized to room rental or splitting without activity-specific proof.
Leegstandwet 2026 fee EUR 114.40 is activity-specific and likewise not reused for other housing activities.
remainingAllowedOnly: concrete-address current-plan determination for ordinary room rental/splitting
activity-specific documents/studies and fee generated by that concrete route

verified: Municipality confirms the current transitional/integrated Omgevingsplan framework.
Delegatiebesluit omgevingsplan Enkhuizen is current from 11-03-2025 and confirms active Omgevingswet plan governance, including delegated modification powers for parts of the plan.
records.futureSignal: Municipality is preparing a new structured Omgevingsplan with intended establishment around end 2026; final rules must be compared when adopted.
remainingAllowedOnly: concrete-address/integrated-plan determination for ordinary room rental/splitting

verified: Huisvestingsverordening gemeente Ermelo 2026 is current from 17-12-2025.
The regulation is primarily an allocation instrument and is not falsely expanded into a generic conversion/splitting permit regime without operative text.
Official application preparation uses DSO/Omgevingsloket, concept request where useful, DigiD and participation documentation.
remainingAllowedOnly: concrete-address current Omgevingsplan/policy determination for ordinary room rental and woningsplitsing
activity-specific documents/studies and exact current fee where generated or positively published

verified: Current Omgevingsplan CVDR696269 supplies an unusually detailed splitting application matrix including splitting plan, recent building-condition/foundation/gas-electricity reports and VvE consent where applicable.

Current Bibob policy confirms that room-rental businesses and conversion/splitting into rooms/multiple dwellings are explicit risk categories, reinforcing that these activities are recognized in the municipal permit framework.
records.feeCurrentnessFinding: The originally indexed Legesverordening Eemnes 2026 version was valid only through 02-04-2026. Therefore no fee from that superseded version is encoded. A successor/current tariff table must be positively located before adding a 2026 fee.
remainingAllowedOnly: exact application channel/decision period where not already inherent in the Omgevingsloket route
address-specific plan applicability and dynamic extras

staleFeePrevention: Eemnes superseded early-2026 leges version not used
